name: yaptake
description: Edit video for every feed (9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9) in a native Mac app with a transcript, captions and timeline. Local tools let coding agents work on the same project.

interface.longDescription:
Edit video for every feed (9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9) in a native Mac app with a transcript, captions and timeline. Local tools let coding agents work on the same project.

Requires the separately installed Yaptake app and its local command on Apple silicon with macOS 26.0 or later.
